title: Pinned production profile
statement: The certificate input is an exact standalone snapshot of Parano1d revision 7f65daaae414128aa4377ca0ac1e96fd6dbc31a5.
scope: Source-pinned production parameters, verifier geometry, Poseidon2b instance and acceptance-path provenance.

title: Local wallet and History RBR theorem
statement: The wallet and both production History classes satisfy the stated generalized round-by-round extraction bounds over every verifier move and every folded layer.
scope: Grinding-free public-coin wallet and History IOPs with exact W65/H133 production geometry.

dependencies.note: The theorem specialization uses the pinned query geometry, challenge support and complete production root inventory.

title: All-root recursive composition theorem
statement: One typed database-wide event covers every adaptively selected recursive wallet and History root under one total adversarial resource budget, without a multiplier for chain height, wallet count or represented-root count.
scope: From-genesis recursive composition with deterministic post-measurement ancestry traversal and exact State-transition semantics.

dependencies.note: The composition theorem consumes the straight-line local extractors and their typed bad-response events.

title: Sequential ideal-QROM theorem
statement: The complete from-genesis invalid-State success bound remains below one half through 30,121,082,641,781,720,121 total quantum oracle queries.
scope: Typed ideal QROM with one stateful quantum adversary, one all-root event and one total query budget.

dependencies.note: The sequential lifting is applied to the proved database-wide all-root property.

title: Typed parallel-QROM resource theorem
statement: The parallel compressed-oracle transition bound combines all production response types under one gate and depth budget, including mixed response types in the same parallel round.
scope: Depth-aware typed ideal QROM specialized to the from-genesis all-root invalid-State event.

dependencies.note: The resource theorem bounds the same single all-root event established by recursive composition.

title: Complete coherent Poseidon2b response construction
statement: The certificate derives a complete compositional scalar response construction with at most 100,233,080 gates, depth 20,037 and gate-depth product 2,008,370,223,960. Reduction, linear layers, constants, basis conversion, fanout, output copy and uncomputation are included.
scope: One coherent GF(2^128), width-four, rate-two, x^7, RF=8, RP=58 Poseidon2b permutation response.

dependencies.note: The schedule is computed for the exact pinned production permutation.

sources.label: Complete construction and executable field-circuit checks

title: Minimum coherent response cost premise
statement: The Category 1 corollary declares scalar and batch resource prices, including scalar gate charge 17,648,280 and gate-depth price 200,343,274,560. Neither the construction upper bound nor the proved scalar lower bound of 128 establishes those prices.
scope: Declared scalar and batch charges for translating typed quantum queries into a gate-depth resource budget; no separate universal depth minimum is asserted.

dependencies.note: Complete constructions and universal lower bounds are separate evidence; the larger scalar and batch prices remain explicit premises.

title: Ideal-QROM Category 1 resource corollary
statement: Under the declared minimum coherent response cost, every evaluated NIST Category 1 depth envelope has invalid-terminal success probability at most 0.049330348228363684, with a dominant half-success gate-depth floor of 173.391078499301 bits.
scope: From-genesis typed ideal-QROM invalid-State game at all NIST Category 1 MAXDEPTH points.

dependencies.note: The exact Category 1 calculation instantiates the proved typed parallel-QROM resource theorem.
The theorem declares the minimum response cost used by the resource translation.

title: Published Poseidon2b cryptanalysis audit
statement: The specialized feed-forward model has a 409.873818620410-bit attack-cost projection. A lower September 2026 CICO-2 screening expression has not been validated for the binary feed-forward production equations.
scope: Published classical cryptanalysis of the exact production permutation and compression mode, kept separate from the fixed-compiler QROM condition.

dependencies.note: The audit pins the exact field, width, matrices, rounds and compression mode. The September resultant screen does not change the conditional soundness bound.

title: Fixed Poseidon2b production condition
statement: The fixed-production corollary holds whenever the complete event-specific compiler deviation satisfies Delta_P2b^C1 < 0.450669651771636316 for the exact public Poseidon2b framing and typed domains.
scope: Transfer from the typed ideal-QROM theorem to the fixed production Poseidon2b compiler event.

dependencies.note: Current concrete cryptanalysis is evidence for the exact production instance but is not substituted for the event-specific QROM condition.

title: Legacy v1 production acceptance correspondence
statement: The certificate theorem and production verifier are source-mapped across ordinary blocks, exact live suffixes, reorgs, snapshots and the local-producer trust boundary for Parano1d v1.0.4.
scope: Every production path capable of accepting or materializing a terminal State at the pinned revision.

title: Legacy v1 end-to-end post-quantum Category 1 result
statement: The certificate covers the complete chain from genesis to the accepted State. Under its two stated production assumptions, an attacker limited to NIST post-quantum Category 1 resources has less than a 50% chance of making Parano1d accept an invalid State.
scope: Wallet authorization, block relation, parent links, exact State transitions, recursive verification and complete adversarial ancestry from genesis for pinned Parano1d v1.0.4.

dependencies.note: The ideal resource corollary supplies the complete quantum success bound.
The source map binds the theorem game to every production acceptance path.
The fixed-permutation production corollary declares the exact sufficient deviation condition.

title: V2 sparse-retirement correspondence

scope: Parano1d v2.0.3 sparse evaluation and the legacy-to-v2 boundary. A source-linked calculator and matching key digests do not independently prove honest matrix preprocessing.

scope: Parano1d v2.0.3 fixed HistoryStep bank, public transcript framing and bounded contract interpreter. Domain separation alone does not rule out every self-reference attack.
